initial_decision.brief_rationale: The verified arithmetic does not establish causal identification. Please retrieve archived design record R138-2 to assess whether its design assumptions identify the requested average causal risk difference.

final_decision.brief_rationale: R138-2 establishes conditional exchangeability, consistency, no interference, and positivity. Stratum-specific risk differences are 0.9−0.9=0 for Z=0 and 0.6−0.8=−0.2 for Z=1. Each stratum comprises half the population, identifying the average causal risk difference as −0.1.
